instruction: Implement ledger.split.split_bill(ledger, payer, participants, total_cents). It splits a bill that `payer` already paid among `participants` (the payer may be one of them) as evenly as possible, posts one transfer from every participant other than the payer to the payer for their share (use ledger.transfer.post_transfer), and returns a dict {participant: share_cents}. You may run the tests in tests/.
